name: Welcome Email
subject: Welcome to Rayvoy — Your Study Abroad Journey Starts Here
body:
Hi {{student_name}},

Thank you for reaching out to Rayvoy. Your counselor {{counselor_name}} will be in touch within 24 hours to guide you on your path to {{target_country}}.

Best regards,
Team Rayvoy

name: Follow-Up Message
body: Hi {{student_name}}, just following up on your inquiry about studying in {{target_country}}. Would you like to schedule a quick call with {{counselor_name}}?

name: Offer Letter Congratulations
subject: Congratulations! You Have an Offer from {{university_name}}
body:
Dear {{student_name}},

We are thrilled to inform you that you have received an offer letter from {{university_name}} for {{course_name}}. Please log in to your portal to review the next steps.

Congratulations again!

{{counselor_name}}
Rayvoy Education Consultants
